summary: Defines DHCP options for finding the controller of the Broadcast and Multicast Service (BCMCS) in 3G cellular networks. A mobile node can be configured through DHCP to reach a particular controller, and the document defines the related options and codes. It is a standards-track memo.

eli5.summary: A phone needs to know which office to contact to receive a broadcast show. This memo gives a way for the network to tell it the office's address automatically.
